column7: Can I get you anything else?\n

column8: @from-v005

column6: 毎度あり！\n大事に使{08:52}欲しいね。\n

column7: Is this all?\n

column7: Hmm, let's see......\nCould you settle for about this much?\n
column8: reads: うーん、そうだなあ‥‥。\nこれぐらいで我慢してくれないかな。\n @from-ours

column7: Okay. I'll purchase it at that price.\n

column8: reads: あー、そうだ @from-v005
reads: くん、ちょっと待って。\n @rebase-new
